title: Candidate flow day log — Ethan R.
content:
Today goal: clear the backlog of 'confirmations' + reschedule 2 no-shows + finish panel prep for SWE IC4 loop. Quick wins first (confirm windows), then blockers (hiring mgr conflict).

MORNING BATCH (09:00 - 11:30)
- 9:00 quick scan: 14 open candidate touchpoints (filter: needs-confirmation, timezone unknown)
- 9:10 email templates: update timeslots for PST/EST overlap (see canned below)
- 9:25 call w/ Priya — status sync on candidate pipeline for Mobile role (she will follow up with recruiter Amber on feedback)
- 9:40 confirm TZ for: Lina M. (applied via referral) — listed as CET, propose 13:00 UTC / 9:00 ET
- 10:00 follow-up sent to Noah P. (no-show yesterday) — propose 2 reschedule windows, mark as "last attempt" after Fri 3/26
- 10:30 block 30m to update hiring manager availability matrix (GH PR link in Confluence)

LUNCH / QUICK BREAK 11:30 - 12:15 (check slack for PM question re: offer banding)

AFTERNOON (12:15 - 17:30)
- 12:20 confirm panel for SWE loop (Panel: Taryn, Lee, Marco). Taryn requested earlier end time — moved to 16:00-17:00 PT
- 12:35 prep notes for panel (bullet list below) + paste into Google event notes
- 13:00 call w/ Samir to triage compensation band request from Hiring Ops (capture details: base, equity, sign-on)
- 14:00 candidate screen: Priya shadowing (takeaways: candidate strong on systems, weak on concurrency examples — flag for Sr Eng interview)
- 15:15 reschedule reminder to Alex K. (candidate requested Tue or Thu afternoons). Sent Tue/Thu 13:00-16:00 PT slots.
- 16:45 finalize inbox triage: move completed threads to folder "done-2026-03"
- 17:15 end-of-day quick notes + update status in Airtable (column: last_contact, next_action)

CANNED EMAILS / QUICK TEMPLATES (copy-paste friendly)
- Confirmation request (short):
  "Hi {Name},

  Quick note to confirm our interview scheduled for {Date} at {Time} {TZ}. Reply with a preferred time if this doesn't work. Looking forward to it!

  — Ethan"

- Reschedule (after no-show):
  "Hi {Name},

  Sorry we missed you today. Are you still interested in continuing the process? I have these windows available: {Slot1}, {Slot2}. If I don't hear back by EOW, I'll close this slot.

  — Ethan, Recruiting Coordinator"

- Panel prep snippet (to paste into event):
  "Focus areas: system design breadth, past ownership + metrics, coding: algorithms + edge-case handling. Please flag if candidate can't answer follow-ups or needs another round. Interview length: 45m + 10m debrief. Scoring rubric: skills, role fit, communication.

  Known issues: candidate mentions limited concurrency experience — bring a systems question."

OPEN QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS
- Hiring manager for SWE4 still has calendar conflicts next week — do we move to a different interviewer or adjust loop order? (ask Taryn & Lee)
- Offer band approval pending from Compensation by Fri 3/26 — Samir following up
- Candidate timezone not in profile for 3 candidates — need to add to Airtable or confirm in email

MEASUREMENTS / KPIs I care about today
- Clear "needs-confirmation" bucket by EOD (target: 0)
- Close 3 no-show follow-ups (result: either rescheduled or marked as closed)
- Panel fully staffed for Monday loops (confirm all panelists + backup)

MINOR TODOS (quick checkbox style)
- [ ] Add timezone field to candidate CSV export (reminder: ask Data Ops)
- [x] Update Google event for SWE loop (changed to 16:00 PT)
- [ ] Send 2nd follow-up to candidates with incomplete app materials
- [ ] Create short "day-of" checklist for panelists (one-pager)
- [ ] Archive old interview notes for closed candidates (Q1 cleanup)

NOTES TO SELF (voice memo topics)
- record 2-min note: how I handled repeated no-show workflow (for playbook)
- draft short Slack post for #recruiting: "Panel tips — keep to 45m, please post feedback within 24h"

END-OF-DAY WRAP (what I'll update before logging off)
- Move threads to Done or Follow-up folder
- Update Airtable next_action + date
- Quick message to hiring managers: summary of any late-stage candidates rescheduled
- Leave notes for morning: top 3 priorities for Thurs

Rough thoughts / brain dump (not polished)
- We should test sending calendar invites with both local TZ and UTC in subject for EU candidates — reduces confusion
- Maybe make a tiny form for candidates to pick 2 backup times (auto-add to calendar) — ask Eng for small automation
